# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	Both pull-request runners are busy with five jobs ahead, past the ten-minute limit, so the pull request's job goes to Tenki
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10 connected=tenki usual=6
job	linux	pr	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	5
gone	no
now	1793000000
runner	online	true	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	online	true	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	online	false	self-hosted,linux
expect	tenki	tenki-standard-small-2c-4g	no	busy	own:busy
words	Your runners were busy, so this ran on Tenki.
